newsitem.title: USA: Bairnco stake raised by Marvin Schwartz.
newsitem.headline: Bairnco stake raised by Marvin Schwartz.

text.p: Marvin Schwartz, general partner of the New York limited partnership Neuberger & Berman, said Thursday he raised his stake in Bairnco Corp to 922,800 common shares or 9.59 percent from 7.45 percent held previously.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Schwartz said his latest transactions include the purchase of 70,000 common shares between November 27 and December 26 at prices ranging from $6.125 and $6.6175 per share.
Schwartz acquired the stake for investment purposes, the filing said.
